provenance: RETROSPECTIVE FORMALISATION -- authored 2026-09-06, after screening. It records the criteria the review's object states it applied, in the object's CORRECTED form (the 2026-09-04 restatement). It is NOT a pre-registration and claims no prospectiveness. A frozen v1.0 markdown protocol (iv_iron_hf_protocol_v1.0) also exists and is what the served page currently renders; this protocol is grounded in the OBJECT instead, and the two disagree -- see carries_forward and the diff report.

carries_forward.what: The object RETRACTED the outcome clause from its eligibility criterion, citing Cochrane Handbook 6.5 section 3.2.4 (eligibility must not depend on which outcomes a study reported, as that admits selective-outcome-reporting bias). The original eligibility sentence is preserved verbatim on the object under eligibility_superseded_2026_09_04.
carries_forward.must_not_be_dropped: A rebuild of this review MUST NOT reintroduce an outcome as an eligibility criterion. The frozen v1.0 markdown protocol lists 'Outcome (primary): CV death or HF hospitalization composite' as a PICO field; carrying that into eligibility would revert the object's own retraction.
carries_forward.must_not_be_narrowed: The object's population is 'heart failure'; the served v1.0 protocol says 'HFrEF'. HFrEF is NARROWER than the review applied. This protocol keeps the object's wording and flags the discrepancy rather than silently adopting either.

population.criterion: Adults with heart failure and iron deficiency.
population.threshold: Iron deficiency as ferritin <100 ng/mL, or 100-299 ng/mL with TSAT <20%.
population.guideline: ESC Heart Failure guideline, iron-deficiency definition
population.provenance: Population and 'iron deficiency' READ from screening.eligibility; the numeric ferritin/TSAT threshold is the ESC 2021 iron-deficiency definition, recorded with its version so a later guideline change is trackable. The object states 'heart failure', NOT 'HFrEF' -- the v1.0 markdown's 'HFrEF' is narrower and is not adopted here.

intervention.criterion: INTRAVENOUS iron, as ferric carboxymaltose or ferric derisomaltose. The intravenous route is load-bearing.

comparator.criterion: Placebo OR usual care. The 'usual care' half is load-bearing, not generous: one contributing trial randomised against usual care, so a placebo-only criterion would wrongly exclude it.

design.criterion: Randomised controlled trial. Route (intravenous) is treated by the object as a distinct eligibility axis alongside P/I/C and is captured in the intervention criterion.
design.provenance: DERIVED (RCT) from review structure; route READ from screening.eligibility

outcomes_reporting.note: Outcomes are a REPORTING field, not eligibility -- this is the whole point of the 2026-09-04 correction. A trial meeting population/intervention/comparator/route that has no extractable cell for an endpoint is recorded ELIGIBLE_OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE, never excluded.

outcomes.name: A designated clinical-event endpoint, or a registered functional primary a regulator relies on
outcomes.role: contribution to a given outcome (NOT eligibility)
outcomes.verbatim_from_object: The outcome criterion is that the trial designates a CLINICAL-EVENT endpoint, or a registered functional primary that a regulator relies on.
